add_blocklist.description: Subscribe Pi-hole to a blocklist (or an allowlist) by its address. Run Update gravity after it to start using its domains.
add_blocklist.name: add_blocklist

parameters.description: The list's address, such as https://example.com/hosts.txt.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: A blocklist blocks its domains; an allowlist never blocks them.
parameters.name: list_type

parameters.description: A note saying what it is, shown in Pi-hole.
parameters.name: comment

parameters.description: The Pi-hole group it applies to; several separated by commas. Leave blank for the Default group.

description: Control Pi-hole, the network-wide ad blocker: pause blocking for a few minutes and turn it back on, report the day's numbers and top blocked domains, allow or block domains, manage blocklists and update gravity, and search the query log. Start a workflow when blocking is turned off or on, or a domain is blocked.

pihole_blocking_changed_trigger.description: Runs when Pi-hole's ad blocking is turned off (from its menu, by a timer or by another app) or back on, or only one of the two. A pause shorter than the workspace's polling interval may be missed.

parameters.description: Only when it's turned off, or only when it's turned back on. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: change

pihole_domain_blocked_trigger.description: Runs when Pi-hole blocks a domain, for the domain or device you watch: once per domain and device each time it looks, with how many queries were blocked. Queries blocked before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only this domain. * matches any characters, such as *.example.com. Leave blank for every domain.
parameters.name: domain

parameters.description: Only queries from this device: its IP address or hostname, as Pi-hole's Query Log shows it. Leave blank for every device.
parameters.name: device
